names: Sodium tartrates (i) Monosodium tartrate (ii), Disodium tartrate

more_info.overview: E335 covers monosodium and disodium tartrate, which are different sodium salts of tartaric acid. Its acidity-regulating role is to adjust or maintain the pH of the food. One specified form is supplied as colourless crystalline material. EU permissions include canned or bottled fruit and vegetables.
more_info.uses:
Examples in the EU food-use list include certain canned or bottled fruit and vegetables.
The entries apply to particular food categories and may limit the amount, the preparation or the way it is used; they do not show how often the additive appears in retail products.
more_info.daily_intake: 0-30 mg/kg body weight (JECFA, 1973). The combined group limit is expressed as L(+)-tartaric acid.
